mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, we are looking at overcast skies around Harriet Park with the temperature sitting at 62 degrees and a Full Moon cycle currently underway.

There are two major updates for the city. First, a stretch of Highway M near the new Aldi location will be closed from October 5 to October 7 for road work. Additionally, residents are reminded that fall leaf collection begins on October 5, so please remember to keep piles behind the curb.

There is plenty to do in our area. Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or check out live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness on September 28 or join the fun at Hop Haus trivia this coming Tuesday.
Regarding local public safety, police reported an incident on September 10 where a 19-year-old was taken into custody for burglary and recklessly endangering safety at a location on Hunters Cove Way.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Oreo Reese's Cheesecake. The store is currently open and will be serving up treats until 10:30 PM tonight.
